executive_summary: US equity markets are experiencing severe tech capitulation, marking the worst weekly pullback for megacap tech since 2020. Semiconductor heavyweights NVDA, AVGO, and MU suffered double-digit daily declines amid rising skepticism over massive AI capital expenditures and macro rotation into defensive non-tech sectors. Despite heavy regular-session liquidation, selective institutional buying (Tepper, Wood) and minor post-market price stabilization suggest an impending tactical relief bounce.

recommendations.catalyst: Stock trades at ~15x earnings after deep multi-week drawdown; 13F filings show fresh accumulation from David Tepper and Cathie Wood.
recommendations.strategy: Scale in via partial tranches near $125-$130 range; restrict position size to 3% max pending broader tech market stabilization.
recommendations.risk: Hyperscaler AI capex deceleration and ongoing semiconductor sector rotation.
